cards.title: Authentication
cards.description: Login, session handling and permission checks shared across projects.

children.title: Route Guards
children.description: Route guards check user permissions before a protected route loads.

notes.text: Prefer functional guards (CanActivateFn) over class-based guards — they support inject() directly and need no NgModule providers.
A guard returning false silently cancels navigation. Redirect to a login or error route instead of returning false so the user isn't left on a blank screen.

children.title: Dependency Injection
children.description: AuthService is provided at the root level so it can be injected into guards and components as a singleton.
